rag.text:
Test: TC-2804 — Box Module - Board - Basic operations - Checking shared parameters
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-34 Box Module - Board - Basic operations
Labels: can_be_automated, teamagile

Steps:
1. Navigate to the Board module of the boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-2804 Box Module - Board - Basic operations - Checking shared parameters
   Expected: The Board module is visible. Four Sub-boxes are visible. Tasks are visible on Board.
2. Click on the Share button, on the right to the module selector.
   Expected: Share view modal window is visible with the URL. Two buttons are visible: Get help and Copy URL to clipboard
3. Click 'X' button in right upper corner.
   Expected: Modal window closes. Board module is visible again.
4. Click on the Share button, on the right to the module selector again.
   Expected: Share view modal window is visible with the URL. Two buttons are visible: Get help and Copy URL to clipboard.
5. Click 'Get help' button.
   Expected: [https://appfire.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DLPDRAFT/pages/297861777/Share+view|https://appfire.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DLPDRAFT/pages/297861777/Share+view] Opens in a new tab.
6. Return to BP tab and click 'Copy URL to clipboard' button
   Expected: The button is green for a moment. URL is copied to the clipboard.
7. Close the modal. Click 'View' button from the header and choose 'Layout' > 'Compact'
   Expected: Cards on board are smaller and have one row.
8. Collapse all swimlanes.
   Expected: All swimlanes are collapsed. No tasks are visible.
9. Open new incognito tab, go to same instance and log in as different user. Go to TC-2804 in this browser tab. Open new tab in browser, paste the link that is copied to clipboard. If necessary paste the link again after being logged in.
   Expected: A Shared view settings window is displayed. The folLowing text is visible: "As this shared view settings may differ from the ones you are currently working with, decide what to do:"
Two options are displayed underneath:
- Adjust my current view
- Keep my settings

'Continue' button and 'Don't ask again' checkbox are also visible.
10. Select 'Keep my settings' and click on 'Continue'.
   Expected: Default view for box is displayed. You can see 5 expanded teams with tasks. Layout is set to Regular
11. Open new incognito tab and paste the link again.
   Expected: A Shared view settings window is displayed. The folLowing text is visible: "As this shared view settings may differ from the ones you are currently working with, decide what to do:"
Two options are displayed underneath:
- Adjust my current view
- Keep my settings

'Continue' button and 'Don't ask again' checkbox are also visible.
12. Select 'Adjust my current view' and click on 'Continue'.
   Expected: 5 Swimlanes are collapsed. Layout is set to Compact
